description: This file implements the functionality for creating a new article within the application. It defines data models, validation logic, a command object, a command validator, and a handler class that processes the creation request by interacting with the database context and handling related entities such as tags and authors.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Data transfer object representing the article's input data, including optional title, description, body, and tag list.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validator for ArticleData ensuring that Title, Description, and Body are not null or empty.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Request command encapsulating the ArticleData for creating a new article, implementing IRequest to be handled by MediatR.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator for Command ensuring the Article property is not null and valid.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of a new article, including fetching the author, processing tags, creating the article entity, and saving it to the database.

methods.name: Create.Handler.Handle
methods.description: Asynchronous method that processes the creation command, resolves or creates tags, associates them with the article, saves all entities, and returns an envelope containing the created article.
